title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
content: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

title: Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA
content: Bitcoin Magazine Cross River Bank Launches Its First Bitcoin-Backed Loans With LendingUSA Cross River Bank has launched its first bitcoin-backed loans with LendingUSA, offering $10,000 to $250,000 at 30%, 50% or 70% loan-to-value. title: Bitcoin Core Patches Node-Stall Bug Found by Block’s AI Scanner
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Core Patches Node-Stall Bug Found by Block’s AI Scanner Bitcoin Core fixed a medium-severity bug that could freeze a node’s block processing for over a dozen seconds per message, a flaw first found by Spiral’s Project Loupe AI scanner. title: Bitcoin Price Surges Above $64,000 as Nvidia Reinstates CEO

title: UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues
content: Bitcoin Magazine UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues The FCA's final rules bar U.K. crypto exchange operators from trading against their own capital on venues they run from Oct. 25, 2027, while a Treasury order clears third-party market makers to trade without a dealing permission. This post UK FCA Bars Crypto Exchanges From Market Making on Their Own Venues first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
